results.title: Penn squanders 17-point lead, game-winning field goal attempt falls just short in 28-27 defeat to Columbia
results.description: After an extra-long night, it all came down to a last-second field goal at Franklin Field. But there was no storybook ending for kicker Mason Walters and the Quakers on Friday.

results.title: Bishop McNamara, Clifton Central secure conference titles: Daily Journal Week 9 football roundup
results.description: Bishop McNamara and Clifton Central secured conference titles with blowout wins, Kankakee finished off an unbeaten conference season, Momence clinched a playoff spot with a comeback win and more in the Daily Journal Week 9 football roundup.

results.title: NBA Notes: Warriors, Dalen Terry, Pacers, Tyrese Haliburton, Nuggets
results.description: The Warriors plan to waive Dalen Terry, but they’d like to keep him around in the G League. Per Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints, Golden State likes Terry and suggests he could begin the season with Santa Cruz in the G League.

results.title: Sooryavanshi posts two-word message after sitting out 4 straight matches
results.description: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi has remained on the bench for all four T20Is against West Indies and posted "still believing" on social media ahead of the series decider. Head coach Gautam Gambhir backed Sanju Samson and Abhishek Sharma as openers, saying Sooryavanshi must wait for his opportunity but will receive a longer run once selected.
